provenance.method: band probe: one band's FFNs -> q2_k at a time, rest at base; delta vs reference. Source was BF16 (16.02 bits read from the file), so the Q6_K reference and the band files are both built from genuine high precision - the cleanest source in the atlas.
provenance.note: fragility_ratio 2.13 uses the atlas convention - worst delta over the TRUE median of the four bands (0.5001). The probe's own log line prints '+1.07 vs median 0.63' (~1.70) because it displays a rounded upper-middle value; both numbers describe the same curve and neither is wrong. Same divergence disclosed on the qwen3.6-35b and qwen3.8-27b entries. Monotone and back-heavy, like every Qwen measured so far and unlike Mistral-7B, whose fragile band is at the FRONT (0-7, ratio 27) - Law 3 holds: fragility is measurable, not predictable.
provenance.harvested: Committed to the atlas 2026-08-20. The probe ran 2026-08-11 under prereg #100 and its curve sat in the raw log for nine days without becoming reusable - a measured result that never turned into an artifact. Nothing was re-measured; every number here is read from that log.
